headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.4848). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.63 (95% CI: 0.37–1.08), indicating no statistically significant association between mediterranean_diet and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 93.12%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
